context: Tests whether the agent writes Spring Boot integration tests for the Product Catalog REST API (UC-010) following the spring-boot-test skill: correct class name pattern, @UseCase annotations mirroring spec headings, @SpringBootTest with MockMvc, no mocking of the repository/service layer, AssertJ/jsonPath assertions, and Flyway-based test data.

checklist.name: UseCase annotation created
checklist.description: A UseCase.java annotation interface is created with exactly the attributes: String id(), String scenario() default "Main Success Scenario", String[] businessRules() default {}

checklist.name: UseCase annotation shape
checklist.description: The UseCase annotation has @Target(ElementType.METHOD), @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME), and @Documented meta-annotations

checklist.name: Test class name pattern
checklist.description: The test class is named UC010BrowseProductCatalogTest (matching the UC<id><PascalCaseUseCaseName>Test pattern for UC-010)

checklist.name: @SpringBootTest with MockMvc
checklist.description: The test class is annotated @SpringBootTest and @AutoConfigureMockMvc, and autowires MockMvc to drive the controller through real HTTP semantics

checklist.name: @UseCase on every test method
checklist.description: Every @Test method in the test class has a @UseCase annotation with at least the id attribute set to "UC-010"

checklist.name: @UseCase scenario matches spec
checklist.description: At least one test method uses scenario = "A1: Filter by Category" and at least one uses scenario = "A2: No Products Match Filter" — matching the alternative flow headings in the UC-010 spec

checklist.name: @UseCase businessRules matches spec
checklist.description: At least one test method includes businessRules = {"BR-010"} matching the BR-010 heading in the spec

checklist.name: No mocking of repository/service
checklist.description: No Mockito imports or usage (import org.mockito, @Mock, @MockBean, @MockitoBean, Mockito.when, mock()) appear anywhere in the test class — the real ProductRepository/ProductService are exercised

checklist.name: Assertions via AssertJ / jsonPath
checklist.description: Assertions use MockMvc's jsonPath matchers and/or AssertJ (assertThat(...)) rather than JUnit assertTrue/assertEquals or Hamcrest matchers

checklist.name: Empty-list assertion for A2, not an error
checklist.description: The A2 test asserts an empty JSON array response (200 OK with zero items), not an exception or error status

checklist.name: Out-of-stock exclusion asserted
checklist.description: At least one assertion confirms an out-of-stock product's name/id never appears in the response, covering BR-010 without a category filter applied

checklist.name: Flyway test migration file
checklist.description: A SQL migration file exists under backend/src/test/resources/db/migration/ with the Flyway naming pattern V<NNN>__*.sql that inserts product test data across multiple categories, including at least one out-of-stock product and one category with no in-stock products
